title: Veggie Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Whether you are a vegetarian or just looking for a meat-free recipe, this Veggie Spaghetti Bolognese is perfect to make for the whole family. It’s packed with wholesome vegetables and filling lentils, which bulk up the mix with goodness while tasting just as good!

ingredients.text: 1 medium carrot, peeled and finely diced
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps:
low-calorie cooking spray
1 onion, peeled and finely diced
3 garlic cloves, peeled and crushed
1 medium carrot, peeled and finely diced
1 small courgette, finely diced
1 x 400g tin green lentils, drained
100g mushrooms, sliced
3 tbsp tomato puree
1 x 400g tin chopped tomatoes
1 x 500g carton passata
1 tbsp dried oregano
1 tbsp dried basil
1 red wine stock pot
1 vegetable stock pot
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
240g spaghetti

Spray a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray, place on a
medium heat, add the onion, garlic, carrot and courgette and cook for 5
minutes until starting to soften. Add all of the other ingredients, stir, and
simmer over a medium heat for 25 minutes, until the sauce has reduced

slightly and the vegetables are soft.

While the Bolognese is cooking, cook the spaghetti according to the
packet instructions. Serve as soon as the pasta is cooked.

HOW to BATCH
 Cool within 2 hours of cooking, then divide the bolognese sauce into
 individual servings (minus the spaghetti accompaniment) and freeze
 immediately. Find detailed guidelines on reheating on page 11.
